notes.title: The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse Patch Notes Spanish Edition!
notes.content:
Saludos a todos,

An exciting new addition has been made to The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse for all Spanish speaking players.  Today we have released a patch that adds Spanish as one of the supported languages.  All text in the game has been translated, including the addition of subtitles to the cinematics.  If you were holding off on getting the game because of Spanish language availability you can now try the first book for free to see!
[list]
    [*]Added a Spanish language translation to all of the text in The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse
    [*]Added English and Spanish subtitles to the game cinematics
    [*]Fixed an issue where the ability Insight Humanoids was not properly giving its damage bonus
    [*]Fixed a bug where the Dart Game in Book 3 would have a sequence break if the Aim Middle option was selected
[/list]
Feliz jugando!

notes.title: The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse Patch Notes All Books Released!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

For those eagerly awaiting the conclusion of The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse we have good news! Books 4 & 5 are now available!  Discover new twists to the story, confront new enemies, and come face to face with the Enchantress.  If you haven’t already, now is a great time to pick up the Season Pass. Try the first book for free!
[list]
    [*]Books 4 and 5 are now available.
    [*]Equipment in narrative sequences will immediately update if it is changed in Party Details.
    [*]Fixed an issue with Cripple 4 not reducing affected target’s damage.
    [*]Counterattack will no-longer do full damage to target if it has Shield.
    [*]Resolved an issue that would prevent main quest progression after completing a Sidequest.
    [*]Made an improvement to how cards overlap with other UI elements on some resolutions.
    [*]The Esc key will now close the reward popups.
[/list] 
[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/newbooksrelease.jpg[/IMG]
https://youtu.be/4grQBO5OEFw
Happy Playing!

notes.title: The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse Patch Notes May 6th
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Surge no longer affects the damage dealt to the character using ‘Attack Self’ abilities.
    [*]Resolved some text related issues with equipment in Party Details.
    [*]Adjusted how conditions and their description popups are displayed when the player’s have the maximum ‘Hand Size’ in 16:10 resolutions.
    [*]Updated the information on the Complete Book popup to clarify book progression.
    [*]Fixed an issue where both party members could equip the same equipment.
[/list]

notes.title: The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse Patch Notes April 27th
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue where the game was not properly using the difficulty setting selected by the player.
    [*]Fixed an issue where in some cases the the enemy’s health would increase every time a combat sequence was re-loaded.
    [*]V-Sync has been enabled and set to match the players monitor refresh rate. This is to help those who may experience screen tearing and to prevent graphics cards from working harder than required.
    [*]Added tooltips for stats on party details.
    [*]The options menu should now properly display the correct defaults when loading the application for the first time.
    [*]Steam Achievement will now appear when the achievement requirement is met instead of upon closing the game client.
[/list]
